purpose: Executable denominator for fundamental constants, dimensionless ratios, CODATA/SI inputs, and constant-recovery claims.

fundamental_constant_rows.constant_or_parameter_object: Defining constant, measured constant, dimensionless ratio, coupling, mass ratio, conversion factor, fixed code parameter, or metadata-only constant invoked by FAMILYC-EW-CODE.
fundamental_constant_rows.dimensionless_constant_test: Separate dimensional constants fixed by unit convention from dimensionless constants or invariant ratios; declare whether the route predicts, fits, imports, normalizes away, or merely names each constant.
fundamental_constant_rows.metrological_input_test: Declare CODATA/SI/experiment/survey/simulator origin, uncertainty, covariance, epoch, adjustment basis, and whether the constant is a definition, measurement, nuisance parameter, or candidate-native output.
fundamental_constant_rows.residual_gap: A correct constant value, fitted coupling, or natural-unit simplification can still be imported from the observed sector, tuned, scheme-dependent, sector-local, or non-identifying.
fundamental_constant_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer observed-sector recovery, fine-tuning solution, constant prediction, or candidate identity from naming, fitting, or unit-fixing constants alone.

fundamental_constant_rows.fundamental_constant_class: metadata/provenance wrapper; not a physical constant claim
fundamental_constant_rows.constant_or_parameter_object: Manifest timestamps, revision numbers, row counts, bundle names, and archive constants used only for custody and replay.
fundamental_constant_rows.dimensionless_constant_test: Archive identifiers are not dimensionless physical constants and cannot be used as evidence of physical constant recovery.
fundamental_constant_rows.metrological_input_test: Metadata row counts and revisions are audit facts, not CODATA/SI or laboratory metrology inputs.
fundamental_constant_rows.residual_gap: Metadata constants support provenance only; they do not predict or explain any physical constant.
fundamental_constant_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer physical constant recovery, fine-tuning resolution, or candidate identity from stable metadata identifiers.
